stories.headline: Anthropic’s 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO
stories.summary: At the upgraded $83/share IPO price, Anthropic's seven founders each pocketed $280 million, while the company nabbed nearly $105 billion.

stories.headline: Anthropic rival says companies can (mostly) skip the pricey models
stories.summary: On the day Anthropic went public, Fireworks AI’s co-founder made the case for open-source models as a cheaper alternative, and addressed the breaches that have cost the company some customers’ trust.

stories.headline: Want to see your live AI usage on your Mac’s icons? This clever new app lets you
stories.summary: IconSwapper brings your Mac's app icons to life with real-time data, animations, and playful customizations that make your desktop more fun.

stories.headline: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
stories.summary: Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That's according to a job listing spotted by Bloomberg , which says Apple is looking for an engineer to lead the creation of an agentic AI assistant.

stories.headline: A brief history of Nvidia’s recent stock fluctuations
stories.summary: Traders work on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange during morning trading on November 18, 2026 in New York City. | Image: Getty Images "We've got this," Colette Kress, interim CEO of Nvidia, said Tuesday night as she closed out the embattled chip company's third quarter earnings call.

stories.headline: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
stories.summary: European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.

stories.headline: Next round of BBC cuts will be more noticeable to audiences, report warns
stories.summary: The BBC has already cut jobs, programmes and services but has further to go to reach its £500m target.

stories.headline: Iowa residents asked to evacuate Friday ahead of Army detonation
stories.summary: The Army plans to detonate 68 barrels of degraded lead azide in Middletown, Iowa, at noon Friday. Forecasts show a dust plume moving north and staying west of the Chicago area, but sampling will determine where lead lands.

stories.headline: Trump pardons late baseball great Pete Rose after historic China trip
stories.summary: On the way back from his Asia trip, President Donald Trump said Thursday he issued a "complete and total pardon" to baseball legend Pete Rose, who died in 2024.

stories.headline: 'I tell my son it's just fireworks': People inside besieged Yemeni city speak to BBC
stories.summary: Orla Guerin speaks to seven people trapped in Taiz by the Houthis who reveal what life is like under siege.
